name: hud_line_clip_set_current_bounds_from_rect_i
description: HudLineClip::SetCurrentBoundsFromRectI converts a HudRectI into the module-current float line-clip bounds.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4bd6f0 has no callees and converts rect left/top/right/bottom integer fields to float globals g_HudLineClip_CurrentMinX/MinY/MaxX/MaxY.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4bd6f0 has no warnings or tags and shows the four float global writes.
The native line-clip smoke sets integer bounds and verifies the four current float bounds.
